pip.name: Youngster Pip
pip.intro: Hey! You walked into my sight. That means we battle!
pip.defeat: Aww... I need to train more.

mira.name: Lass Mira
mira.intro: My monsters are cute AND strong. Let me show you!

rook.name: Bug Catcher Rook
rook.intro: Shh! You'll scare the moths! ...Fine, battle me instead!
rook.defeat: My moths fluttered off. Good battle.

moss.name: Hiker Moss
moss.intro: These rocks and I have walked a long way. Test yourself against us!

gil.name: Fisher Gil
gil.intro: Nothing's biting today. Maybe you will!
gil.defeat: Reeled in by a better angler...

vera.name: Ace Trainer Vera
vera.intro: Few make it this deep into the cave. Bring your friends, you'll need them.
vera.defeat: Impressive. You might actually survive the bosses.

dell.name: Rancher Dell
dell.intro: Out here on the steppe, the wind decides who wins. Let's see whose side it's on!

sol.name: Climber Sol
sol.intro: I climbed all the way up here for a worthy rival. Is that you?
sol.defeat: The summit belongs to you today.

nim.name: Archaeologist Nim
nim.intro: These ruins hide ancient fusions. Mine are the oldest of all!

kael.name: Dragon Tamer Kael
kael.intro: Nothing survives the Wastes unless it is fused for fire and fury. Prove you belong!
kael.defeat: You... you have the heart of a tamer.

aurelia.name: Champion Aurelia
aurelia.intro: So you earned every badge and made it to my throne. My six legendaries answer to no one: one of them will face each of you, and they grow stronger with every challenger. Show me everything you have!
aurelia.defeat: Magnificent... The land is yours to protect now, Champion.

tess.name: Gym Trainer Tess
tess.intro: Nobody reaches Leader Brannoc without getting past me!
tess.defeat: Hmph. Brannoc won't crumble that easily.

brannoc.name: Leader Brannoc
brannoc.intro: I am Brannoc, the Stonehold Gym Leader! My monsters are as hard as the bedrock under your feet. Bring your friends, if you like!
brannoc.defeat: You cracked the bedrock! Take the Bedrock Badge, your Stone moves hit harder now.

watt.name: Engineer Watt
watt.intro: Bzzt! Unauthorized visitor! Initiating battle protocol!
watt.defeat: Short-circuited... go on, the Leader's waiting.

zara.name: Leader Zara
zara.intro: Welcome to the Voltage Gym! I'm Zara, and my storm never stops. Think you can keep up?
zara.defeat: What a shock! You've earned the Surge Badge, your Spark moves will crackle harder.

coral.name: Swimmer Coral
coral.intro: Splash! You'll have to swim through me first!
coral.defeat: Washed out... the Leader's tide is way stronger than mine.

reef.name: Diver Reef
reef.intro: I've been holding my breath waiting for a challenger!
reef.defeat: Gasp! Okay, okay, you can pass.

marina.name: Leader Marina
marina.intro: The ruins sank, but my gym never did. I am Marina, and the tide answers to me!
marina.defeat: The tide has turned... The Riptide Badge is yours. Now go face the Champion!
